recipe.title: Recipes
recipe.text: Build a glaze from materials and amounts, see its unity formula, and save it.

material.title: Materials
material.text: Add raw materials of your own, from a chemical formula or a supplier’s analysis.

additive.title: Additives and colorants
additive.text: Keep the colorants and opacifiers you add on top of a base glaze.

firing.title: Firing logs
firing.text: Record times, temperatures and cones for each firing.

notes.title: Notes
notes.text: Keep test results and anything else worth remembering.

advice.title: Glaze advice
advice.text: Tips on mixing, glazing and firing, and your own advice.

guides.title: Guides
guides.text: From what a glaze is to firing it, and keeping everyone safe on the way.

home.newHere: New to unity formulas? The <advice>advice page</advice> explains the basics, and the <about>about page</about> says how Glazecalc works.
